WITH mix_counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded') AS order_type_mix,
    COUNT(*) AS behavior_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS t
    ON a.translink = t.transreg
  GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertypedist, 'No mix recorded')
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    behavior_count,
    CAST(behavior_count AS REAL) / SUM(behavior_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM mix_counts
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    order_type_mix,
    behavior_count,
    share,
    AVG(share) OVER () AS baseline_share
  FROM shares
)
SELECT
  order_type_mix,
  behavior_count,
  share,
  share - baseline_share AS above_baseline
FROM scored
WHERE share > baseline_share;

assumptions.assumption: A NULL ordertypedist is the only form of an unrecorded mix, and the display label 'No mix recorded' does not collide with a recorded mix value.
